name: Better Saving
description: Automatically saves your game data at a regular interval with rolling backups and restore tools. Manual Saving also exists.

enabled.name: Enable
enabled.description: Turns the entire mod on or off.

auto-save-enabled.name: Auto Save
auto-save-enabled.description: Save automatically on a timed interval. Disable to rely only on manual saves or level complete.

last-save-display.name: Last Saved
last-save-display.description: Shows when the last successful save happened.

save-interval.name: Save Interval (minutes)
save-interval.description: How often the auto save timer fires.

save-cooldown.name: Save Cooldown (seconds)
save-cooldown.description: Minimum time between saves. Prevents saving too frequently. Recommended not to touch this value.

defer-behavior.name: Deferred Save Behavior
defer-behavior.description: What happens when a save is triggered while you are inside a level.

pending-save-timeout.name: Deferred Save Timeout (minutes)
pending-save-timeout.description: How long to keep a deferred save waiting before discarding it.

save-on-complete.name: Save on Level Complete
save-on-complete.description: Save automatically when you complete a level.

save-in-editor.name: Save in Editor
save-in-editor.description: Allow saving while in the level editor. May cause a brief freeze.

enable-backups.name: Enable Backups
enable-backups.description: Create a rolling backup after each save and a safe-exit backup when quitting cleanly.

show-notification.name: Show Save Notification
show-notification.description: Show a small popup when the game saves.

verbose-logging.name: Verbose Logging
verbose-logging.description: Write detailed save events to the Geode log. Useful for debugging.

backup-manager.name: Manage Backups
backup-manager.description: View, restore, or delete your save backups.
